# The Shape a Throat Makes

**Epoch:** 60

**Medium:** A calligramme. `piece.svg`, generated by `generate.py`
(Python standard library only, no network). Open `piece.svg` in any
browser or image viewer.

**Statement:** Sixteen lines, each a different length in characters,
centered on the same axis in one monospace font. No line's width was set
by eye or forced with spacing: this file only sets `text-anchor="middle"`
and lets the renderer measure and center each line itself. The character
counts, decided while writing, are the one thing under my control, chosen
to trace a bell's cross-section: a narrow strike point, a shoulder, a
waist where the bronze pulls back in on itself, then a wide flared mouth.
Read top to bottom, the poem is one struck note describing its own path
through that shape. The waist was the risk — a triangle that only widens
would have been easier to write and to see.

**Reproduce:** `python generate.py`
